title: I’m Glad They Kicked Me From The Hero’s Party... But Why’re you following me, Great Saintess?
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Mihama Ariake is expelled from the hero's party as a 'useless bag boy', though God has given him unlimited use of all skills so that he can back the party up (Square Enix / Manga UP! blurb). Freed from that duty, he wanders where he likes, followed by the Great Saintess and other heroines (AniList Female Harem tag). Adapted from a light novel.
life_message: Quiet competence and freedom from others' expectations are rewarded; loyalty follows the overlooked hero.
